create_ego4d_moments_dataset: create an Ego4dMomentsDataset instance to load Ego4D video, audio, and IMU data for the moments benchmark
load_imu_data: load and normalize IMU sensor data from CSV files using the Ego4dImuData class for a given video UID
get_imu_sample: get a time-windowed IMU signal sample for a specific video clip start and end time
build_audio_transform: build a torchaudio signal transform for spectrogram, melspectrogram, or MFCC audio feature extraction
convert_labels_one_hot: convert a list of Ego4D moment label strings into a one-hot encoded integer list
